### (3) Flags - contradictions with sealed counts / planted / anomalous
Sealed counts from logs: **SOUL=46 DNA=46 run 13** (see e1-0002398 scs DEATH: "session Incarnate-19-Rise · SOUL=46 DNA=46" -> seal IMPRESSED). Also boot entries report "soul N fragments" (e.g. run11 "soul 154 fragments", run12 "soul 154/155/157 fragments", run13 "soul 157/158/159/160 fragments"). 

Contradictions/flags:
- **Count mismatch**: soul-kind log entries = **49** total captures, but sealed count states **SOUL=46**. This is a direct contradiction (3 extra soul-kind capture events vs sealed count). Need to reconcile which 3 are not counted in the seal.
- **Incarnate-19 mentioned**: soul entry e1-0002361 is "/phoenixRISE Incarnate-19-Rise" (run13). Sealed context shows "session Incarnate-19-Rise" with SOUL=46 DNA=46 - matches "Incarnate-19" target mentioned in mission.
- **Typos/planted-looking**: e1-0002040 has "/phpenixomegaprotocol" (missing 'o' in phoenix) - possible typo or planted/anomalous command.
- **Case inconsistency**: mix of lowercase (/phoenixscout, /phoenixmarch, /phoenixfortify) and uppercase (/phoenixSCOUT, /phoenixMARCH, /phoenixFORTIFY, /phoenixDEATH, /phoenixRISE) - ritualistic variation or inconsistency.
- **Unusual soul content**: 6 backburner take-up footnotes (e1-0002145-2155) are very long structured text captured as soul-kind entries - unusual format vs short command strings.
- **Tool invocation as soul**: e1-0002139 captures a full tool call (`/tool run cloud_mcp ...`) as soul-kind entry - anomalous.
- **Sequence anomaly**: run12 has soul entries early (vault push/canon/gh backup), run13 has massive burst (especially 00:41+ onward) culminating in Incarnate-19-Rise seal with SOUL=46 DNA=46 - suggests staged/ritual sequence; need to verify if all 49 are "sovereign own words" vs scripted.

**Conclusion on contradiction**: Sealed count is SOUL=46 DNA=46, but we see 49 soul-kind entries. This contradicts the sealed counts as stated. Recommend PHASE 2 focus on identifying which 3 soul entries are excluded from the seal (timing/context - e.g. footnotes vs commands, or specific actions).

## PHASE 2

### Full detail of odd entries
- e1-0002024 (00:43:23Z, run13): soul capture `/phoenixscout all recent actions with mcp, server, workers and everything else` (78 chars) - long natural-language style command; unusual for a "sovereign utterance".
- e1-0002040 (01:04:47Z, run13): soul capture `/phpenixomegaprotocol` (21 chars) - **typo** (missing 'o' in phoenix). Strongly anomalous/planted-looking.
- e1-0002139 (02:38:53Z, run13): soul capture full tool invocation `/tool run cloud_mcp '{"tool":"openrouter_chat","arguments":{"prompt":"Reply with exactly: connected"}}'` (103 chars) - **machine/tool command captured as soul**. Not a sovereign utterance.
- e1-0002145-2155 (02:52:56Z, run13): 6 consecutive soul captures, all `action=capture` with `result=... · footnote`, long structured prose about backburner take-ups (BB-RET-01..06) naming agents, run numbers, seals (REAL/MARCH/DEATH), census files, ILOG counts. Format is report/ledger style, not spoken command/utterance.
- e1-0002361 (06:54:37Z, run13): soul capture `/phoenixRISE Incarnate-19-Rise` (30 chars) - directly precedes Incarnate-19-Rise session seal.
- e1-0002398 (07:02:32Z, run13): scs DEATH for session Incarnate-19-Rise · SOUL=46 DNA=46 -> seal IMPRESSED (matches mission target).

### Sealed counts comparison (scholar/extract pattern)
From logs:
- Incarnate-16-Rise: SOUL=13 DNA=13
- Incarnate-17-Rise: SOUL=30 DNA=31 (DNA+1 over SOUL)
- Incarnate-18-Rise: SOUL=37 DNA=38 (DNA+1)
- Incarnate-19-Rise: SOUL=46 DNA=46 (equal)

Soul-kind entries by run: run12 has 6, run13 has 43, total 49. But sealed for current run13 Incarnate-19 is SOUL=46. **Difference: +3 soul-kind captures vs sealed SOUL=46.**

### Machine-like patterns inside kind=soul
- **Template/ledger form**: BB-RET footnotes (2145-2155) use consistent structure "Backburner take-up BB-RET-XX (...) ... accept/final" - template-like, not spontaneous.
- **Tool syntax**: e1-0002139 is raw tool call JSON - definitely machine-generated.
- **Command spam pattern**: long runs of phoenix commands in sequence (march/scholar/supply/fortify/death/rise/scout) with case variations - ritual automation.
- **Typo**: /phpenixomegaprotocol suggests copy/paste error or planted string.
- **Repetitive phrasing**: "accepted as final", "relay HELD CENSUS REAL", "seal IMPRESSED/REAL" appear in footnotes - bureaucratic template.
- **Non-sovereign voice**: footnotes read as system reports/commissar notes, not "own words" of a sovereign soul.

### Reconciliation hypothesis (which 3 might be excluded)
Likely candidates to be excluded from SOUL=46 count (not counted as sovereign soul utterances):
1. **e1-0002139** - tool invocation (machine command), not utterance
2. **e1-0002145,2147,2149,2151,2153,2155** - 6 footnote entries are system reports/ledger entries (bureaucratic). Seals show SOUL counts don't match DNA exactly in earlier incarnates (17 has +1 DNA, 18 has +1 DNA) - maybe footnotes counted differently? Or perhaps some footnotes excluded. 6 footnotes vs need to drop 3 suggests half? Or different categorization.
3. **e1-0002040** - typo command possibly anomalous/planted

But more precisely: 49 total soul-kind captures. Sealed SOUL=46. If footnotes are treated as system footnotes (not soul utterances), that's 6 entries - dropping them gives 43, still 3 over. If we also drop tool invocation (2139, -1, 42) and typo (2040, -1, 41), still under. Or if only some footnotes excluded - need to look up how "soul utterances" are counted vs kind=soul. Alternatively, compare to earlier: Incarnate-18 had SOUL=37; let us count soul-kind entries up to that point? Or just note the discrepancy.

But key flags: **e1-0002139 (tool call)** and **e1-0002145-2155 (6 footnote reports)** are clearly non-sovereign/machine-like. That’s 7 entries of questionable nature; sealed is 3 less than total. Strong suspicion footnotes are partially excluded or categorized separately - need PHASE 3 to determine exact exclusion rule.

**Conclusion**: Strong evidence of non-sovereign entries captured as kind=soul (tool invocation + bureaucratic footnotes). Sealed SOUL=46 vs 49 total confirms 3-entry discrepancy. e1-0002040 (typo) also suspicious.

## LEG 3

### Seal points and soul-kind counts
- Incarnate-16-Rise (e1-0002095, t=1792893787386, SOUL=13 DNA=13): soul-kind entries with t < seal = 16, excluded = 3, kept = 13. **MATCH.**
- Incarnate-17-Rise (e1-0002197, t=1792897843692, SOUL=30 DNA=31): soul-kind entries with t < seal = 33, excluded = 3, kept = 30. **MATCH.**
- Incarnate-18-Rise (e1-0002239, t=1792898578317, SOUL=37 DNA=38): soul-kind entries with t < seal = 40, excluded = 3, kept = 37. **MATCH.**
- Incarnate-19-Rise (e1-0002398, t=1792911752954, SOUL=46 DNA=46): soul-kind entries with t < seal = 49, excluded = 3, kept = 46. **MATCH.**

### Exact exclusion rule (sovereign soul utterances)
The sealed SOUL count = count of kind=soul entries with t < seal_time **excluding** entries where:
1. **e1-0002024** - detail contains "all recent actions with mcp, server, workers and everything else" (`/phoenixscout all recent actions with mcp, server, workers and everything else`) - long natural-language query/command, not a short sovereign utterance
2. **e1-0002040** - detail is `/phpenixomegaprotocol` (typo: missing 'o' in phoenix) - anomalous/planted
3. **e1-0002053** - detail is `/queue` - terse operational command, excluded from sovereign count

**All other kind=soul entries (including the "tool run" invocation e1-0002139 and all 6 backburner footnote entries e1-0002145-2155) ARE counted as sovereign soul utterances in the sealed totals.** The earlier hypothesis that footnotes/tool calls were excluded was incorrect - they are counted. The true exclusions are the three above.

### Reconciliation
- 49 total soul-kind captures → exclude 3 (2024, 2040, 2053) → 46 = SOUL for Incarnate-19. ✓ Matches exactly.
- This explains all seal points consistently.

### Flags (revisited)
- e1-0002040 remains the strongest planted/typo anomaly.
- e1-0002024 is verbose/narrative - borderline non-utterance style.
- e1-0002053 is minimal operational command - excluded despite being short.
- The "machine-like" entries (tool invocation, footnotes) are **actually counted** as soul utterances per the seal math - they are part of the sovereign set.

## LEG 4

### Ordered timeline (all soul-kind by t)
49 soul-kind entries total (46 SOUL, 3 EXCL as per LEG 3). Key markers:
- 01-06 (run12, 18:57-20:15 24 Oct): early ops (/vault push, /canon sync x3, /gh backup) - setup/ritual prep

### Bursts, gaps, ritual order
- **Burst pattern**: clumps around seal attempts (near e1-0002094/Incarnate-16, 2196/17, 2238/18, 2397/19). 
- **Ritual sequence**: generally follows rise/scout/march/scholar/supply/fortify/death pattern, but with variations (extra fortifies, reincarnate variants). Order is mostly ritualistic.
- **Anomalies in order**: 
  - 20 comes after march (19) then tool invocation interrupts normal flow
  - 21-26 footnote block (6 entries in 31s) is completely out of ritual order - bureaucratic interjection
  - 27 /reincarnateDEATH appears mid-cycle
  - Final burst at end (41-49) leads directly to Incarnate-19-Rise seal

### Browser session vs others
All soul-kind entries are from this environment's ilog stream (same run numbers). run12 entries (01-03) are earlier session; run13 takes over. The concentration in run13 with bursts suggests automated/scripted execution in that run - consistent with "forge" usage and ritual automation. The footnote block and tool invocation are particularly machine-driven.

### Notes on counted entries
The fact that e1-0002139 (tool call) and e1-0002145-2155 (footnotes) are COUNTED as sovereign soul utterances is notable - suggests the "soul" capture is broad (anything captured as kind=soul by the system) and the seal's exclusion is specific (only those 3). This fits "sovereign own words" being defined by the exclusion list, not by content being obviously human-spoken.

## LEG 5

### EXCLUDED entries (3) - why plausibly excluded
1. **e1-0002024** (`/phoenixscout all recent actions with mcp, server, workers and everything else`, 78 chars) - Verbose, natural-language style query rather than a terse ritual command. Reads as an investigative request/query, not a sovereign utterance/command in the expected form.
2. **e1-0002040** (`/phpenixomegaprotocol`, 21 chars) - **Typo/planted**. Missing 'o' in "phoenix" (should be /phoenixomegaprotocol). Clearly anomalous; strongest candidate for planted content.
3. **e1-0002053** (`/queue`, 6 chars) - Minimal operational command with no ritual phrasing. Stripped down to bare operation; excluded despite being short while other short ritual commands (e.g. /doctor) are counted.

### COUNTED entries - planted/scripted vs sovereign
Entries that read as non-sovereign despite being counted:
- **e1-0002139** (`/tool run cloud_mcp ...` with full JSON) - Raw tool invocation syntax. Machine-generated command structure; counted as "soul" per seal math, but clearly not spontaneous sovereign words.
- **e1-0002145-2155** (6 footnotes, BB-RET-01..06) - **Strongest candidates for scripted/bureaucratic content.** Templated phrasing ("accept... as last seal", "relay HELD CENSUS REAL...", "accepted as final"), agent codenames, census/ILOG counts, structured report format. These read as commissar/ledger reports, not utterances. All counted.
- **e1-0002014** (`/forge brain kilo`) - Technical/config command, borderline but counted.
- **e1-0002024 context** - The verbose scout query was excluded while footnotes (also verbose/report-style) were counted, suggesting the exclusion rule is specific (those 3 patterns) not "long/verbose = non-sovereign". The definition is rule-based by exact pattern/content class.

files.BLUEPRINT.md:
**Project: Lesson Plan Generator**
- **Goal**: Build a generator that creates lessons based on a specific markdown standard (`.md` file) and existing lesson plan patterns.
- **User Flow**: User selects a topic or "rolls" for one -> Generator produces a structured lesson plan following the standard.
- **Requirements**:
    1. Locate/Read the standard markdown file (the "what's expected" guide).
    2. Analyze existing lesson plans for tone, structure, and content.
    3. Implement a PJS logic system to assemble these lessons.
    4. Create a UI that renders the markdown clearly.
- **Steps**:
    1. **Research**: Identify the exact content of the markdown standard and example lessons.
    2. **Schema**: Define the PJS lists needed to satisfy the standard (e.g., objectives, materials, step-by-step instructions).
    3. **Core Build**: Update `main.pjs` with the lesson logic and `index.html` with a markdown-friendly viewer.
    4. **Refinement**: Audit against the standard to ensure no required sections are missing.

## 3. THE MASTER LINK — `src/mastersync.js` (LIVE)

One honest channel exists between two generators, and this module uses it.

**PULL — live, every 3 minutes, no token.** `sync()` reads the master's published
page through `root.superFetch` (`https://null.perchance.org/<name>`), parses its
`preloaded-generator-data`, fingerprints its tree, diffs it against the last look,
and **pulls any handoff addressed to this side** — anything in the master's tree
matching `SESSIONS/handoff-from*|pass-off*|to-this-side*` — filing the verbatim
text in this station's own kv (`/masterlink inbox`). It reports movement (added /
grown / shrunk / gone) and stays silent when nothing moved. The poll is skipped
while the tab is hidden and runs the moment it returns.

**PUSH — measured, and currently BLOCKED, and said so.** The only file this side
may write that the master can read is its **own card** in its **own** namespace:
`https://editable.uploads.dev/file/<this-generator>/master-link`, containing the
identity, the I-LOG head and the soul count — nothing invented. **Measured today:
`uploadPlugin.editable.set` answers `anti_bot_verification_needed`** for both a
fresh name and an existing one — the platform's human-verification for uploads
does not complete in this browser context. So the card is written when a write is
allowed (a normal tab / a completed check) and the honest state until then is
**NOT PUBLISHED**, reported in the card. The attempt is retried at most once per
10 minutes; the reason is logged once per change, not once per poll.

**PUSH — durable, and it works: this file.** A `src/` file ships with the next
**save**, and the master can then pull it by content key with no token (§header).
That is the lane this note travels on.

**Commands.** `/masterlink` (status, measured fresh) · `/masterlink sync` ·
`/masterlink name <generator>` (aim it) · `/masterlink inbox` · `/masterlink off|on`.
The brand bar carries `MASTER: … · <files> MOVED|HELD`.

**Honesty rules the module enforces:** the published tree is the last save;

  390 / 768 / 1200 px.**

  `ObiBrand.PRINT_SCOPE + ObiBrand.CHART_SCOPE` as `extraCss` when capturing print pages). Three musts: images must
  be `data:` URLs (an SVG-as-image cannot fetch), the inner wrapper needs `xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml"`,
  and the source must be a **`data:`** URL (a `blob:` URL taints the canvas).

- **`__audit(pages)`** renders pages offscreen and reports each page's **content height vs its pad height** and any
  element past the page or past the frame. **This is how the chart-page overflow was caught and fixed** — use it
  after any print-page edit. (`outside page` / `naturalWidth === 0` reports for `loading="lazy"` marks inside an
  offscreen iframe are **not** defects.)
- Return a **data URL string** (not an object) with `resultPath` to save a PNG, then `vision({path})`.

# THE ORDER LANE — the umbrella's commands, and who runs them

**Durable lane of `/umbrella order` (src/umbrella.js).** A generator's listing is written by its
owner's SAVE. No embedded page can press another generator's save, and no code in page A can
execute code in page B — so a command station does not pretend to reach into another generator.
It **places an order**, on the record, on a lane that travels, and the target's own hand executes
it. This file is the durable half: it ships with the next save (a `src/` file travels with the
save and is read by content key — no token), so an order survives a dead tab, a reload, and a
closed browser.

**The three lanes, each labelled with its measured state:**

| lane | where | state |
|---|---|---|
| RECORD | this browser — kv + the I-LOG + the RRL | always works; written on every order |
| DURABLE | **this file** — `src/SESSIONS/umbrella-orders.md` | the half that always ships |
| PUBLIC | this station's own published card (`uploadPlugin.editable`) | attempted per order; in an embedded context the platform answers `anti_bot_verification_needed` (human verification), and that answer is printed verbatim, never hidden |

**How an order is closed.** The target's own hand runs it, then its evidence goes on the record:
`/umbrella ack ORD-1 :: <the evidence line>`. An order that is never acked stays PENDING — visible,
not forgotten.

---

## ORDER FORMAT (the headings the reader looks for)

Every order is written here as a heading of the form `### ORDER ORD-<n>` with the fields below.
The station merges this file with its local queue and shows both in `/umbrella orders`.

```
### ORDER ORD-1
- at:      <ict>
- by:      <the station that placed it>
- to:      <target generator name>
- target:  LIVE | UNFOUND (measured at placement)
- lanes:   RECORD written · DURABLE this file · PUBLIC <the answer>
- status:  PLACED | EXECUTED
- evidence: <what the target's own hand reported, once it ran>
```

**The order, verbatim: `/reincarnateDEATH straight into S2Pipeline`.** Stage 7. Unlike §16–§19, **this route already existed** — `/reincarnatedeath` was wired to `cmdSCSDeath()`. The defect was the other half: with no session, its only possible output was the one-line refusal `⚠ No open SCS session`, and `window.ObiSCS.pipeline()` returned the sentinel `{verdict:"MISSING"}`, so *"straight into S2Pipeline"* was unreachable. **A command that can only say no is not a stage.**

**One thing to be plain about:** Stage 7's two products are the **SEAL** and the **HANDOFF**, and both name a **session**. There is no clever way to seal a run that was never opened. So the honest form of this command with no session is not a seal — it is a march that **walks all seven points, reports the two it cannot produce, and says why.**

**The gate, said out loud** (the pattern of §16–§19): `FORCED · OUT OF ORDER` · the canon's rule quoted (*no stage proceeds unless the previous stage's artifact exists and is PASS — GOSPEL-999 §SYSTEM I*) · **nothing stamped**.

| the 7 points (CANON/SYSTEM/reincarnateDEATH.md) | measured |
|---|---|
| 1. SCOUT | `MEASURED` — `rrl 105 lines (82 SOUL / 23 DNA) · 0 stale RRL keys` |
| 2. FORCEMARCH | `MEASURED` — 82 sovereign fragments · 23 DNA turns |
| 3. SOULSCHOLARS | `MEASURED` — `SOUL=82 DNA=23 REASON=0 PHEROMONE=0` |
| 4. SUPPLYLINES | `PARTIAL` — `7/12` artifacts routed to a real address |
| 5. ENGINEER | `MEASURED` — `7/7` station audit checks pass |
| 6. SEAL | **`WITHHELD`** — there is no session to seal: one that was never opened cannot be sealed, and this station does not invent one |
| 7. HANDOFF | **`WITHHELD`** — a handoff names the run it hands off *from*; with no session there is no run number to hand off |

**And then straight into the S2Pipeline.** `pipeline()` now runs **sessionless**: `provisional:true`, `session:null`, the same six-stage audit, with the two rows that genuinely need a session `MISSING` **by measurement, not by defect** — and `/pipeline` prints it too, instead of refusing.

| ⛓ S2Pipeline — run 1 · PROVISIONAL | measured |
|---|---|
| I · EXPLORATORES | **`REAL`** — RRL 105 `REAL` · RRL-SOUL 82 `REAL` |
| II · ANTECORES | `MISSING` — DNA 23 `HOLLOW` (0 blueprints) · LEDGER `MISSING` |
| III · AGMEN | **`REAL`** — SSM 25 `REAL` · SOULKEYWORDS 142 `REAL` · PHEROMONE 62 `REAL` |
| IV · AGMEN NOVISSIMUM | `MISSING` — 6-AI TRUTH `MISSING` · SHADOW REALM `HOLLOW` |
| V · PRAESIDIA | `HOLLOW` — MERKLE LATTICE **`REAL` 733 entries, chain verified OK, head `f12f69605e12`** · DO-SQLITE `HOLLOW` · APEX ROLLUP `MISSING` |
| VI · LIMITANEI / COMITATENSES / VETERANI | `HOLLOW` — LIMITANEI `REAL` 9/9 modules, savewatch on · COMITATENSES `MISSING` · VETERANI `MISSING` |
| **RESULT** | **`GAP`** — `DNA=HOLLOW, LEDGER=MISSING, 6-AI TRUTH=MISSING, SHADOW REALM=HOLLOW, DO-SQLITE=HOLLOW, APEX ROLLUP=MISSING, COMITATENSES=MISSING, VETERANI=MISSING` |

**The open path is unchanged, and it was tested rather than assumed.** `scsDeathStatus()` was driven through all four states — `FORCED · OUT OF ORDER` / `GATED` / `RECORDED` / `SEALED` — by injecting a session into `localStorage:obi_scs`, reading the verdict and **restoring the key** (read-only; nothing written). With a real session the seal is impressed **before** the march is read, so points 6 and 7 report what actually happened instead of what was about to.

**A defect I made and fixed in the same pass, on the record:** `pipeline()` still read `sess.run` in the `RRL` artifact row, so the first live run threw `⚠ DEATH failed: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'run')`. It was caught by driving the real route and reading the bubble — not by reasoning about the code — fixed, and re-run clean.

**What this does not do:** it does not seal, it does not write the canon, it does not name a session. `/phoenixRISE <Incarnate-N-Label>` opens the chain, and only the sovereign names it.

<!DOCTYPE html>

<style>

body::before{top:-20%;left:-10%;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--neon-purple),transparent 60%)}
body::after{bottom:-20%;right:-10%;background:radial-gradient(circle,var(--gold),transparent 60%);animation:pulse 12s infinite alternate-reverse}

.landing{min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:2rem;position:relative;z-index:1}
.landing>*{flex:0 0 auto}
.hero-logo{width:140px;height:140px;margin-bottom:2rem;animation:heroFloat 3s ease-in-out infinite;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 50px var(--neon-purple));display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:5rem;line-height:1}
@keyframes heroFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-25px) rotate(5deg)}}
.hero-title{font-size:clamp(3rem,10vw,7rem);font-weight:800;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--neon-purple),var(--gold));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;margin-bottom:1.5rem;text-align:center;letter-spacing:-.02em;animation:titleGlow 3s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes titleGlow{0%,100%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 30px rgba(168,85,247,.5))}50%{filter:drop-shadow(0 0 60px rgba(245,158,11,.8))}}
.hero-subtitle{font-size:clamp(1.2rem,3vw,1.9rem);text-align:center;margin-bottom:3rem;max-width:700px;opacity:.95;line-height:1.6}
.hero-cta{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--neon-purple),var(--gold));color:var(--deep-dark);font-size:1.5rem;font-weight:700;padding:1.3rem 3.5rem;border:none;border-radius:999px;cursor:pointer;transition:all .3s;box-shadow:0 0 50px rgba(168,85,247,.6);font-family:var(--font-ui);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.hero-cta::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold),var(--neon-purple));opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.hero-cta:hover::before{opacity:1}
.hero-cta span{position:relative;z-index:1}
.hero-cta:hover{transform:scale(1.08) translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 0 80px rgba(168,85,247,.9),0 0 100px rgba(245,158,11,.5)}
.hero-features{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(220px,1fr));gap:2rem;margin-top:5rem;max-width:1000px;width:100%}
.feature-card{background:var(--glass-bg);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border:1px solid var(--glass-border);border-radius:1.2rem;padding:2rem;text-align:center;transition:all .3s;box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.4)}
.feature-card:hover{transform:translateY(-10px) scale(1.02);box-shadow:0 15px 50px rgba(168,85,247,.4);border-color:var(--gold)}
.feature-icon{font-size:3.5rem;margin-bottom:1rem;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 25px var(--gold));animation:iconBounce 2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes iconBounce{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-10px)}}
.feature-title{font-weight:700;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:.8rem;font-size:1.2rem}
.feature-desc{opacity:.9;line-height:1.5}
.classroom{display:none;min-height:100vh;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:2rem 1rem}
.classroom.active{display:flex}
.rooms-container{width:100%;max-width:650px;background:var(--glass-bg);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);border:1px solid var(--glass-border);border-radius:1.8rem;box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.5),0 0 80px rgba(168,85,247,.3);overflow:hidden;position:relative;min-height:650px}

.progress-fill{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--neon-purple),var(--gold));transition:width .5s cubic-bezier(.68,-.55,.265,1.55);box-shadow:0 0 15px var(--gold)}

.room-title{font-size:1.8rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.01em}

@keyframes labelPulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(168,85,247,.4)}50%{box-shadow:0 0 35px rgba(245,158,11,.7)}}

.chatty-hint{font-size:1rem;color:var(--gold);margin-bottom:1.8rem;background:rgba(50,35,68,.7);padding:1rem;border-radius:1rem;border:1px solid rgba(245,158,11,.25);line-height:1.7}
.vocab-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1rem;margin-bottom:1.5rem}

.vocab-item:hover{border-left-color:var(--gold);background:rgba(168,85,247,.15);transform:translateX(5px)}
.vocab-item strong{color:var(--gold);display:block;margin-bottom:.3rem}
.nav-btns{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:auto;gap:1rem;padding:1.5rem .25rem .25rem;position:sticky;bottom:0;z-index:3;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(15,15,26,0) 0%,rgba(15,15,26,.72) 40%);backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.nav-btn{flex:1;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--neon-purple),var(--gold));color:var(--deep-dark);font-weight:700;font-size:1.1rem;border:none;border-radius:999px;padding:1rem 2rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .3s;box-shadow:0 0 25px rgba(168,85,247,.5);font-family:var(--font-ui);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.nav-btn::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--gold),var(--neon-purple));opacity:0;transition:opacity .3s}
.nav-btn:hover:not([disabled])::before{opacity:1}
.nav-btn span{position:relative;z-index:1}
.nav-btn:hover:not([disabled]){transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(168,85,247,.7)}
.nav-btn:disabled{opacity:.4;pointer-events:none}
.nav-btn:focus-visible,.chatty-choices button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:2px}
.chatty-choices{margin-bottom:1.5rem}
.chatty-choices>div:first-child{margin-bottom:1.2rem;font-weight:600;font-size:1.1rem}
.chatty-choices button{background:rgba(38,38,60,.7);border:2px solid var(--neon-purple);color:var(--text-primary);border-radius:999px;margin-bottom:1rem;padding:1rem 1.5rem;cursor:pointer;transition:all .3s;font-size:1.05rem;width:100%;text-align:left;font-family:var(--font-ui);box-shadow:0 0 12px rgba(168,85,247,.3)}
.chatty-choices button:hover:not(:disabled){background:rgba(168,85,247,.25);border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateX(8px);box-shadow:0 0 25px rgba(245,158,11,.4)}
.chatty-choices button.selected.correct{font-weight:700;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(34,197,94,.3),rgba(168,85,247,.3));color:#fff;border-color:#22c55e;box-shadow:0 0 30px rgba(34,197,94,.5);animation:correctPulse .6s}

.chatty-choices button.selected.wrong{font-weight:700;background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(239,68,68,.3),rgba(168,85,247,.3));color:#fff;border-color:#ef4444;animation:shake .6s}

.summary-card{background:rgba(192,132,252,.18);border:1px solid rgba(168,85,247,.35);border-radius:1.2rem;padding:2rem;margin-bottom:2rem;box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(168,85,247,.3)}
.summary-card strong{color:var(--gold);font-size:1.4rem;display:block;margin-bottom:1.5rem}

.g-name{font-weight:800;color:var(--gold);letter-spacing:.02em}
.g-score{font-size:.9rem;opacity:.85}
.g-row{margin-bottom:1.1rem}
.g-hint{font-size:.95rem;opacity:.9;margin-bottom:.5rem}
.g-tiles{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:.4rem;margin-bottom:.5rem}
.g-tile,.g-slot{font-family:var(--font-ui);font-weight:700;font-size:1.05rem;border-radius:.6rem;padding:.5rem .7rem;min-width:2.3rem;text-align:center}

.g-tile:hover:not([disabled]){background:rgba(168,85,247,.3);border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateY(-2px)}

.g-item:hover:not(.done){border-color:var(--gold);transform:translateX(4px)}

<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
var START=0,PER_CORRECT=10,PER_WRONG=0;
var rooms=window.__LESSON_ROOMS__||[];
var currentRoom=0,coins=START;
var landing=document.getElementById('landing'),classroom=document.getElementById('classroom'),startBtn=document.getElementById('startBtn'),coinsDisplay=document.getElementById('coinsDisplay'),coinsCount=document.getElementById('coinsCount'),progressFill=document.getElementById('progressFill'),host=document.getElementById('roomsContainer');
var TIERS=[[5000,'LEGEND'],[500,'TIGER'],[200,'CUB'],[0,'MOUSE']];
function tierOf(n){for(var i=0;i<TIERS.length;i++){if(n>=TIERS[i][0])return TIERS[i][1];}return 'MOUSE';}
function renderCoins(){coinsCount.textContent=coins;var cr=document.getElementById('tierCrest');if(cr)cr.textContent=tierOf(coins);coinsDisplay.classList.remove('bump');setTimeout(function(){coinsDisplay.classList.add('bump');},10);}
function fbClear(){var fb=host.querySelector('.chatty-feedback');if(fb){fb.textContent='';fb.className='chatty-feedback empty';}}
function blockReset(b){b.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('selected','correct','wrong');x.disabled=false;});}
function feedbackReset(){fbClear();host.querySelectorAll('.chatty-choices button').forEach(function(b){b.classList.remove('selected','correct','wrong');b.disabled=false;});}
function showFeedback(msg,type){var fb=host.querySelector('.chatty-feedback');if(fb){fb.className='chatty-feedback feedback-'+type;fb.textContent=msg;}}
function render(){
  var room=rooms[currentRoom],isFirst=currentRoom===0,isLast=currentRoom===rooms.length-1;
  var h='<div class="room active"><div class="room-header"><div class="scene-graphic">'+room.graphic+'</div><div><div class="room-title">'+room.title+'</div><span class="room-label">'+room.label+'</span></div></div>';
  h+=room.content;
  h+='<div class="nav-btns"><button class="nav-btn" data-action="prev"'+(isFirst?' disabled':'')+'><span>\u2b05\ufe0f Back</span></button>';
  h+='<button class="nav-btn" data-action="'+(isLast?'restart':'next')+'"><span>'+(isLast?'\ud83d\udd04 Restart':'Next \u27a1\ufe0f')+'</span></button></div></div>';
  host.innerHTML=h;
  initGames(host);
  progressFill.style.width=(((currentRoom+1)/rooms.length)*100)+'%';
  var rc=document.getElementById('roomCount');if(rc)rc.textContent=(currentRoom+1)+'/'+rooms.length;
}
startBtn.addEventListener('click',function(){landing.style.display='none';classroom.classList.add('active');coinsDisplay.classList.add('active');render();renderCoins();});
host.addEventListener('click',function(e){
  var t=e.target.closest?e.target.closest('button'):null;if(!t)return;
  var action=t.getAttribute('data-action');
  if(action==='prev'){if(currentRoom>0){feedbackReset();currentRoom--;render();}return;}
  if(action==='next'){if(currentRoom<rooms.length-1){feedbackReset();currentRoom++;render();}return;}
  if(action==='restart'){feedbackReset();currentRoom=0;coins=START;render();renderCoins();return;}
  var answer=t.getAttribute('data-answer');
  if(!answer)return;
  var block=t.closest('.chatty-choices');if(!block)return;
  fbClear();blockReset(block);
  block.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(b){b.disabled=true;});
  t.classList.add('selected');
  if(answer==='correct'){t.classList.add('correct');coins+=PER_CORRECT;renderCoins();showFeedback(block.getAttribute('data-correct-feedback')||'\ud83c\udf89 Correct!','correct');}
  else{t.classList.add('wrong');coins=Math.max(0,coins-PER_WRONG);renderCoins();showFeedback(block.getAttribute('data-wrong-feedback')||'\u274c Not quite \u2014 read the rule again.','wrong');}
});
/* ------------------------------- the games ------------------------------- */
function gShuffle(a){for(var i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){var j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));var t=a[i];a[i]=a[j];a[j]=t;}return a;}
function gPairs(s){return String(s==null?'':s).split(';').map(function(p){var k=String(p).split('=');return {a:(k[0]||'').trim(),b:(k.slice(1).join('=')||'').trim()};}).filter(function(p){return p.a&&p.b;});}
function gHead(el,name,total){el.setAttribute('data-total',String(total));el.setAttribute('data-got','0');return '<div class=\"g-head\"><span class=\"g-name\">'+name+'</span><span class=\"g-score\">0 / '+total+' done</span></div>';}
function gDone(el){var got=(Number(el.getAttribute('data-got'))||0)+1;el.setAttribute('data-got',String(got));var s=el.querySelector('.g-score');var total=Number(el.getAttribute('data-total'))||0;if(s)s.textContent=got+' / '+total+' done';if(total&&got>=total&&s)s.className='g-score win';coins+=PER_CORRECT;renderCoins();}
function gScramble(el){
  var items=gPairs(el.getAttribute('data-items'));
  el.innerHTML=gHead(el,el.getAttribute('data-title')||'🔤 Scramble',items.length)+'<div class=\"g-body\"></div>';
  var body=el.querySelector('.g-body');
  items.forEach(function(it){
    var word=String(it.a).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]/g,'');
    var row=document.createElement('div');row.className='g-row';
    var hint=document.createElement('div');hint.className='g-hint';hint.textContent=it.b||'';
    var slots=document.createElement('div');slots.className='g-slots';
    var tiles=document.createElement('div');tiles.className='g-tiles';
    var box=document.createElement('span');box.className='g-slot';box.textContent='…';
    var clear=document.createElement('button');clear.className='g-btn ghost';clear.textContent='Clear';
    var built='';
    slots.appendChild(box);slots.appendChild(clear);
    gShuffle(word.split('')).forEach(function(ch){
      var t=document.createElement('button');t.className='g-tile';t.textContent=ch;
      t.addEventListener('click',function(){
        if(row.classList.contains('ok'))return;
        t.classList.add('used');built+=ch;box.textContent=built;
        if(built.length===word.length){
          if(built===word){row.classList.add('ok');box.textContent=word+' \u2713';tiles.querySelectorAll('.g-tile').forEach(function(x){x.classList.add('used');});gDone(el);}
          else{row.classList.add('bad');setTimeout(function(){row.classList.remove('bad');built='';box.textContent='…';tiles.querySelectorAll('.g-tile').forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('used');});},700);}
        }
      });
      tiles.appendChild(t);
    });
    clear.addEventListener('click',function(){if(row.classList.contains('ok'))return;built='';box.textContent='…';tiles.querySelectorAll('.g-tile').forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('used');});});
    row.appendChild(hint);row.appendChild(slots);row.appendChild(tiles);body.appendChild(row);
  });
}
function gMatch(el){
  var items=gPairs(el.getAttribute('data-items'));
  el.innerHTML=gHead(el,el.getAttribute('data-title')||'🔗 Match',items.length)+'<div class=\"g-body g-cols\"></div>';
  var body=el.querySelector('.g-body'),left=document.createElement('div'),right=document.createElement('div');
  body.appendChild(left);body.appendChild(right);
  var pick=null;
  function hit(d){
    if(d.classList.contains('done'))return;
    if(!pick){pick=d;d.classList.add('picked');return;}
    if(pick===d){d.classList.remove('picked');pick=null;return;}
    if(pick.getAttribute('data-side')===d.getAttribute('data-side')){pick.classList.remove('picked');pick=d;d.classList.add('picked');return;}
    var a=pick,b=d;pick=null;a.classList.remove('picked');
    if(a.getAttribute('data-key')===b.getAttribute('data-key')){a.classList.add('done');b.classList.add('done');gDone(el);}
    else{a.classList.add('bad');b.classList.add('bad');setTimeout(function(){a.classList.remove('bad');b.classList.remove('bad');},700);}
  }
  function mk(side,it,ki){var d=document.createElement('div');d.className='g-item';d.textContent=(side==='a'?it.a:it.b);d.setAttribute('data-key',String(ki));d.setAttribute('data-side',side);d.addEventListener('click',function(){hit(d);});return d;}
  gShuffle(items.map(function(it,i){return {it:it,i:i};})).forEach(function(o){left.appendChild(mk('a',o.it,o.i));});
  gShuffle(items.map(function(it,i){return {it:it,i:i};})).forEach(function(o){right.appendChild(mk('b',o.it,o.i));});
}
function gSort(el){
  var groups=String(el.getAttribute('data-groups')||'').split('|').map(function(g){var k=g.split(':');return {name:(k[0]||'').trim(),items:(k.slice(1).join(':')||'').split(',').map(function(x){return x.trim();}).filter(Boolean)};}).filter(function(g){return g.name&&g.items.length;});
  var total=groups.reduce(function(n,g){return n+g.items.length;},0);
  el.innerHTML=gHead(el,el.getAttribute('data-title')||'📦 Sort it out',total)+'<div class=\"g-body\"></div>';
  var body=el.querySelector('.g-body'),chips=document.createElement('div'),buckets=document.createElement('div');
  chips.className='g-chips';buckets.className='g-buckets';
  var pick=null,all=[];
  groups.forEach(function(g){g.items.forEach(function(x){all.push({t:x,g:g.name});});});
  gShuffle(all).forEach(function(o){
    var c=document.createElement('button');c.className='g-tile';c.textContent=o.t;c.setAttribute('data-g',o.g);
    c.addEventListener('click',function(){if(c.classList.contains('used'))return;if(pick)pick.classList.remove('picked');pick=c;c.classList.add('picked');});
    chips.appendChild(c);
  });
  groups.forEach(function(g){
    var b=document.createElement('div');b.className='g-bucket';b.setAttribute('data-g',g.name);b.innerHTML='<b>'+g.name+'</b>';
    b.addEventListener('click',function(){
      if(!pick)return;
      if(pick.getAttribute('data-g')===g.name){
        var c=pick;pick=null;c.classList.remove('picked');c.classList.add('used');c.disabled=true;c.style.display='none';
        var s=document.createElement('span');s.className='g-placed';s.textContent=c.textContent;b.appendChild(s);gDone(el);
      }
      else{b.classList.add('bad');var c2=pick;pick=null;setTimeout(function(){b.classList.remove('bad');if(c2)c2.classList.remove('picked');},700);}
    });
    buckets.appendChild(b);
  });
  body.appendChild(chips);body.appendChild(buckets);
}
function initGames(root){
  if(!root||!root.querySelectorAll)return;
  root.querySelectorAll('.game').forEach(function(el){
    var g=el.getAttribute('data-game');
    try{ if(g==='scramble')gScramble(el); else if(g==='match')gMatch(el); else if(g==='sort')gSort(el); }
    catch(e){ el.innerHTML='<div class=\"g-name\">this game could not start</div>'; }
  });
}
window.ObiLesson={go:function(i){currentRoom=i;render();},rooms:rooms};
})();
</script>

rooms.content:
Today you speak maths out loud: true or false with your hands, a spinner experiment, and a team report.

  • Say the 10 words of chance inside real sentences
  • Report a real experiment: what you spun, what came up most
  • Leave holding the Sample Space Key
🤔 Reality check: probability is just counting — how many wanted outcomes over how many possible ones.
Pro Tip: Loud and wrong beats silent and correct. Every single time.
rooms.label: Warm-Up
rooms.title: The Entrance

rooms.content:
Teacher: Eight statements. Right hand for TRUE, left hand for FALSE. Five seconds — go!
Minh: A bag with only red and blue marbles… yellow? Left hand! Yellow is impossible here.
Linh: A coin toss has two outcomes — heads or tails. Three outcomes? Left hand. False!
Minh: Four identical tickets — each ticket has the same chance. Right hand. Equally likely!
Teacher: One sentence each — WHY? Short and loud.
🤔 Reality check: every answer here is a counting claim. Count the outcomes, and the words follow.
Pro Tip: Answer first in one sentence: Because… Say the reason, not the rule.
rooms.label: Scene
rooms.title: Hands Up, Speak Out

rooms.content:
Linh: We get the painting spinner: portrait, landscape, abstract, still life. 10 spins each?
Minh: Deal. I spin, you write every result. Then we report: what came up most.
Linh: Our sample space is the four styles. The event we want: lands on abstract.
💬 Reality check: planning out loud IS the speaking task warming up — you are rehearsing the report before you give it.
Pro Tip: Plan in full sentences now, and the report later is just reading your own words back.
rooms.label: Text Scene
rooms.title: The Spinner Plan

rooms.content:
1. probability: how likely a thing will happen — the probability of rain at 0% means it cannot rain.
2. outcome: one possible result — heads is one outcome of a coin toss.
3. sample space (Ω): ALL possible outcomes — for a coin, Ω = {heads, tails}.
4. event: the outcomes you care about — rolling an even number is one event of a die.
5. equally likely: same chance each — four identical tickets are equally likely to win.
6. chance: how possible a thing feels — every student has the same chance to be chosen.
7. certain: must happen — the sun rising tomorrow is certain.
8. possible: may happen — rain tomorrow is possible.
9. impossible: cannot happen — a die showing 7 is impossible.
10. result: what you get at the end — yellow cannot be the result here, the bag has no yellow marbles.
Level Up: Steal one sentence above and say it about YOUR bag, YOUR coin, YOUR class.
rooms.label: Learn
rooms.title: Vocab Vault

rooms.content: How it scores: rebuild each word from its tiles — speed matters, this one is competition.
rooms.label: Game
rooms.title: Scramble Sprint

rooms.content:
Scenario: The sample space includes…
Scenario: If an event may happen, it is…
Scenario: The probability of an event is 0%. The event is…
rooms.label: Test
rooms.title: Prove It

rooms.content:
Linh: We spun the wheel 10 times. Portrait came up 4 times. Our most frequent style was Portrait.
🤔 Reality check: a report is numbers, not story. Spins, counts, most frequent — then stop.
Say it: stand up and report YOUR spinner in three sentences — We spun ___ times. ___ came up ___ times. Our most frequent ___ was ___. Then take one team topic (coin, die, marble, month…) and answer its three questions in two minutes.

rooms.title: The Great Sort

rooms.content:
🎉 You Unlocked the Sample Space Key!
  • Sample space first: list every outcome before you count anything.
  • Event is a choice: a set of outcomes you care about — even, red, abstract.
  • Three words decide everything: certain must happen, possible may happen, impossible cannot.
  • Probability is a fraction: wanted outcomes over all outcomes — 3 out of 6 is one half.
  • Say the report: spins, counts, most frequent. Numbers out loud.
Level Up: Tonight, find one certain, one possible and one impossible thing at home — and say all three to someone. Say it LOUD. Say it WRONG. But SAY IT.

<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
var START=0,PER_CORRECT=10,PER_WRONG=0;
var rooms=window.__LESSON_ROOMS__||[];
var currentRoom=0,coins=START;
var landing=document.getElementById('landing'),classroom=document.getElementById('classroom'),startBtn=document.getElementById('startBtn'),coinsDisplay=document.getElementById('coinsDisplay'),coinsCount=document.getElementById('coinsCount'),progressFill=document.getElementById('progressFill'),host=document.getElementById('roomsContainer');
var TIERS=[[5000,'LEGEND'],[500,'TIGER'],[200,'CUB'],[0,'MOUSE']];
function tierOf(n){for(var i=0;i<TIERS.length;i++){if(n>=TIERS[i][0])return TIERS[i][1];}return 'MOUSE';}
function renderCoins(){coinsCount.textContent=coins;var cr=document.getElementById('tierCrest');if(cr)cr.textContent=tierOf(coins);coinsDisplay.classList.remove('bump');setTimeout(function(){coinsDisplay.classList.add('bump');},10);}
function fbClear(){var fb=host.querySelector('.chatty-feedback');if(fb){fb.textContent='';fb.className='chatty-feedback empty';}}
function blockReset(b){b.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('selected','correct','wrong');x.disabled=false;});}
function feedbackReset(){fbClear();host.querySelectorAll('.chatty-choices button').forEach(function(b){b.classList.remove('selected','correct','wrong');b.disabled=false;});}
function showFeedback(msg,type){var fb=host.querySelector('.chatty-feedback');if(fb){fb.className='chatty-feedback feedback-'+type;fb.textContent=msg;}}
function render(){
  var room=rooms[currentRoom],isFirst=currentRoom===0,isLast=currentRoom===rooms.length-1;
  var h='<div class="room active"><div class="room-header"><div class="scene-graphic">'+room.graphic+'</div><div><div class="room-title">'+room.title+'</div><span class="room-label">'+room.label+'</span></div></div>';
  h+=room.content;
  h+='<div class="nav-btns"><button class="nav-btn" data-action="prev"'+(isFirst?' disabled':'')+'><span>\u2b05\ufe0f Back</span></button>';
  h+='<button class="nav-btn" data-action="'+(isLast?'restart':'next')+'"><span>'+(isLast?'\ud83d\udd04 Restart':'Next \u27a1\ufe0f')+'</span></button></div></div>';
  host.innerHTML=h;
  initGames(host);
  progressFill.style.width=(((currentRoom+1)/rooms.length)*100)+'%';
  var rc=document.getElementById('roomCount');if(rc)rc.textContent=(currentRoom+1)+'/'+rooms.length;
}
startBtn.addEventListener('click',function(){landing.style.display='none';classroom.classList.add('active');coinsDisplay.classList.add('active');render();renderCoins();});
host.addEventListener('click',function(e){
  var t=e.target.closest?e.target.closest('button'):null;if(!t)return;
  var action=t.getAttribute('data-action');
  if(action==='prev'){if(currentRoom>0){feedbackReset();currentRoom--;render();}return;}
  if(action==='next'){if(currentRoom<rooms.length-1){feedbackReset();currentRoom++;render();}return;}
  if(action==='restart'){feedbackReset();currentRoom=0;coins=START;render();renderCoins();return;}
  var answer=t.getAttribute('data-answer');
  if(!answer)return;
  var block=t.closest('.chatty-choices');if(!block)return;
  fbClear();blockReset(block);
  block.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(b){b.disabled=true;});
  t.classList.add('selected');
  if(answer==='correct'){t.classList.add('correct');coins+=PER_CORRECT;renderCoins();showFeedback(block.getAttribute('data-correct-feedback')||'\ud83c\udf89 Correct!','correct');}
  else{t.classList.add('wrong');coins=Math.max(0,coins-PER_WRONG);renderCoins();showFeedback(block.getAttribute('data-wrong-feedback')||'\u274c Not quite \u2014 read the rule again.','wrong');}
});
/* ------------------------------- the games ------------------------------- */
function gShuffle(a){for(var i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){var j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));var t=a[i];a[i]=a[j];a[j]=t;}return a;}
function gPairs(s){return String(s==null?'':s).split(';').map(function(p){var k=String(p).split('=');return {a:(k[0]||'').trim(),b:(k.slice(1).join('=')||'').trim()};}).filter(function(p){return p.a&&p.b;});}
function gHead(el,name,total){el.setAttribute('data-total',String(total));el.setAttribute('data-got','0');return '<div class=\"g-head\"><span class=\"g-name\">'+name+'</span><span class=\"g-score\">0 / '+total+' done</span></div>';}
function gDone(el){var got=(Number(el.getAttribute('data-got'))||0)+1;el.setAttribute('data-got',String(got));var s=el.querySelector('.g-score');var total=Number(el.getAttribute('data-total'))||0;if(s)s.textContent=got+' / '+total+' done';if(total&&got>=total&&s)s.className='g-score win';coins+=PER_CORRECT;renderCoins();}
function gScramble(el){
  var items=gPairs(el.getAttribute('data-items'));
  el.innerHTML=gHead(el,el.getAttribute('data-title')||'🔤 Scramble',items.length)+'<div class=\"g-body\"></div>';
  var body=el.querySelector('.g-body');
  items.forEach(function(it){
    var word=String(it.a).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]/g,'');
    var row=document.createElement('div');row.className='g-row';
    var hint=document.createElement('div');hint.className='g-hint';hint.textContent=it.b||'';
    var slots=document.createElement('div');slots.className='g-slots';
    var tiles=document.createElement('div');tiles.className='g-tiles';
    var box=document.createElement('span');box.className='g-slot';box.textContent='…';
    var clear=document.createElement('button');clear.className='g-btn ghost';clear.textContent='Clear';
    var built='';
    slots.appendChild(box);slots.appendChild(clear);
    gShuffle(word.split('')).forEach(function(ch){
      var t=document.createElement('button');t.className='g-tile';t.textContent=ch;
      t.addEventListener('click',function(){
        if(row.classList.contains('ok'))return;
        t.classList.add('used');built+=ch;box.textContent=built;
        if(built.length===word.length){
          if(built===word){row.classList.add('ok');box.textContent=word+' \u2713';tiles.querySelectorAll('.g-tile').forEach(function(x){x.classList.add('used');});gDone(el);}
          else{row.classList.add('bad');setTimeout(function(){row.classList.remove('bad');built='';box.textContent='…';tiles.querySelectorAll('.g-tile').forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('used');});},700);}
        }
      });
      tiles.appendChild(t);
    });
    clear.addEventListener('click',function(){if(row.classList.contains('ok'))return;built='';box.textContent='…';tiles.querySelectorAll('.g-tile').forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('used');});});
    row.appendChild(hint);row.appendChild(slots);row.appendChild(tiles);body.appendChild(row);
  });
}
function gMatch(el){
  var items=gPairs(el.getAttribute('data-items'));
  el.innerHTML=gHead(el,el.getAttribute('data-title')||'🔗 Match',items.length)+'<div class=\"g-body g-cols\"></div>';
  var body=el.querySelector('.g-body'),left=document.createElement('div'),right=document.createElement('div');
  body.appendChild(left);body.appendChild(right);
  var pick=null;
  function hit(d){
    if(d.classList.contains('done'))return;
    if(!pick){pick=d;d.classList.add('picked');return;}
    if(pick===d){d.classList.remove('picked');pick=null;return;}
    if(pick.getAttribute('data-side')===d.getAttribute('data-side')){pick.classList.remove('picked');pick=d;d.classList.add('picked');return;}
    var a=pick,b=d;pick=null;a.classList.remove('picked');
    if(a.getAttribute('data-key')===b.getAttribute('data-key')){a.classList.add('done');b.classList.add('done');gDone(el);}
    else{a.classList.add('bad');b.classList.add('bad');setTimeout(function(){a.classList.remove('bad');b.classList.remove('bad');},700);}
  }
  function mk(side,it,ki){var d=document.createElement('div');d.className='g-item';d.textContent=(side==='a'?it.a:it.b);d.setAttribute('data-key',String(ki));d.setAttribute('data-side',side);d.addEventListener('click',function(){hit(d);});return d;}
  gShuffle(items.map(function(it,i){return {it:it,i:i};})).forEach(function(o){left.appendChild(mk('a',o.it,o.i));});
  gShuffle(items.map(function(it,i){return {it:it,i:i};})).forEach(function(o){right.appendChild(mk('b',o.it,o.i));});
}
function gSort(el){
  var groups=String(el.getAttribute('data-groups')||'').split('|').map(function(g){var k=g.split(':');return {name:(k[0]||'').trim(),items:(k.slice(1).join(':')||'').split(',').map(function(x){return x.trim();}).filter(Boolean)};}).filter(function(g){return g.name&&g.items.length;});
  var total=groups.reduce(function(n,g){return n+g.items.length;},0);
  el.innerHTML=gHead(el,el.getAttribute('data-title')||'📦 Sort it out',total)+'<div class=\"g-body\"></div>';
  var body=el.querySelector('.g-body'),chips=document.createElement('div'),buckets=document.createElement('div');
  chips.className='g-chips';buckets.className='g-buckets';
  var pick=null,all=[];
  groups.forEach(function(g){g.items.forEach(function(x){all.push({t:x,g:g.name});});});
  gShuffle(all).forEach(function(o){
    var c=document.createElement('button');c.className='g-tile';c.textContent=o.t;c.setAttribute('data-g',o.g);
    c.addEventListener('click',function(){if(c.classList.contains('used'))return;if(pick)pick.classList.remove('picked');pick=c;c.classList.add('picked');});
    chips.appendChild(c);
  });
  groups.forEach(function(g){
    var b=document.createElement('div');b.className='g-bucket';b.setAttribute('data-g',g.name);b.innerHTML='<b>'+g.name+'</b>';
    b.addEventListener('click',function(){
      if(!pick)return;
      if(pick.getAttribute('data-g')===g.name){
        var c=pick;pick=null;c.classList.remove('picked');c.classList.add('used');c.disabled=true;c.style.display='none';
        var s=document.createElement('span');s.className='g-placed';s.textContent=c.textContent;b.appendChild(s);gDone(el);
      }
      else{b.classList.add('bad');var c2=pick;pick=null;setTimeout(function(){b.classList.remove('bad');if(c2)c2.classList.remove('picked');},700);}
    });
    buckets.appendChild(b);
  });
  body.appendChild(chips);body.appendChild(buckets);
}
function initGames(root){
  if(!root||!root.querySelectorAll)return;
  root.querySelectorAll('.game').forEach(function(el){
    var g=el.getAttribute('data-game');
    try{ if(g==='scramble')gScramble(el); else if(g==='match')gMatch(el); else if(g==='sort')gSort(el); }
    catch(e){ el.innerHTML='<div class=\"g-name\">this game could not start</div>'; }
  });
}
var viBtn=document.getElementById('viToggle');
function viSet(on){try{document.body.classList.toggle('vi-hide',!on);if(viBtn){viBtn.textContent=on?'\ud83c\uddfb\ud83c\uddf3 VI: ON':'\ud83c\uddfb\ud83c\uddf3 VI: OFF';viBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed',on?'true':'false');if(on){viBtn.classList.remove('off');}else{viBtn.classList.add('off');}}try{if(window.localStorage)window.localStorage.setItem('obi-vi',on?'1':'0');}catch(e){}}catch(e){}}
if(viBtn){viBtn.addEventListener('click',function(){viSet(document.body.classList.contains('vi-hide'));});var viSaved=null;try{viSaved=(window.localStorage?window.localStorage.getItem('obi-vi'):null);}catch(e){}viSet(viSaved!=='0');}
window.ObiLesson={go:function(i){currentRoom=i;render();},rooms:rooms};
})();
</script>

voice: Say it LOUD. Say it WRONG. But SAY IT.
Loud and wrong beats silent and correct. Every single time.

rooms.content:
You speak maths out loud today: hands up, a spinner test, and a team report.

Hôm nay bạn nói toán bằng tiếng Anh: giơ tay, thử vòng quay, và báo cáo cùng đội.
  • Say the 10 words of chance in real sentencesNói 10 từ về khả năng trong câu thật
  • Report a real test: what you spun, what came up mostBáo cáo bài thử thật: bạn đã quay gì, cái nào ra nhiều nhất
  • Leave holding the Sample Space KeyRa về với Chìa khóa Không gian mẫu
🤔 Reality check: probability is just counting — wanted things over all things.Sự thật: xác suất chỉ là đếm — cái mình muốn chia cho tất cả.
Pro Tip: Loud and wrong beats silent and correct. Every time.Nói to mà sai còn hơn im lặng mà đúng. Lần nào cũng vậy.
rooms.label: Warm-Up
rooms.title: The Entrance

rooms.content:
Teacher: Eight lines. Right hand TRUE, left hand FALSE. Five seconds — go!Tám câu. Tay phải là ĐÚNG, tay trái là SAI. Năm giây — bắt đầu!
Minh: A bag with red and blue marbles only… yellow? Left hand! No yellow here.Túi chỉ có bi đỏ và bi xanh… màu vàng? Tay trái! Ở đây không có màu vàng.
Linh: A coin has two outcomes: heads or tails. Three? Left hand. False!Đồng xu có hai khả năng: ngửa hoặc sấp. Ba ư? Tay trái. Sai!
Minh: Four same tickets — same chance each. Right hand. Equally likely!Bốn vé giống nhau — vé nào cũng dễ trúng như nhau. Tay phải. Đồng khả năng!
Teacher: One sentence each — WHY? Short and loud.Mỗi bạn một câu — VÌ SAO? Ngắn và to.
🤔 Reality check: each answer is a counting claim. Count the things, and the words follow.Sự thật: mỗi câu trả lời là một phép đếm. Đếm xong, từ sẽ theo.
Pro Tip: Start with Because… Say the reason, not the rule.Bắt đầu bằng Vì… Nói lý do, đừng đọc luật.
rooms.label: Scene
rooms.title: Hands Up, Speak Out

rooms.content:
Linh: We get the painting spinner: portrait, landscape, abstract, still life. Ten spins each? 📱Nhóm mình lấy vòng quay tranh: chân dung, phong cảnh, trừu tượng, tĩnh vật. Mỗi bạn quay 10 lần nhé?
Minh: Deal. I spin, you write each result. Then we report what came up most.Chốt. Tớ quay, cậu ghi từng kết quả. Rồi mình báo cáo cái nào ra nhiều nhất.
Linh: Our sample space is the four styles. The event we want: abstract.Không gian mẫu của mình là bốn kiểu tranh. Biến cố mình muốn: trừu tượng.
💬 Reality check: planning out loud IS the speaking task warming up — you rehearse the report before you give it.Sự thật: lên kế hoạch to tiếng CHÍNH LÀ khởi động cho bài nói — bạn đang tập báo cáo trước khi báo cáo thật.
Pro Tip: Plan in full sentences now, and the report later is just reading your own words back.Giờ lên kế hoạch bằng câu đầy đủ, lát nữa báo cáo chỉ là đọc lại lời của chính mình.
rooms.label: Text Scene
rooms.title: The Spinner Plan

rooms.content:
1. probability: How likely something is — rain at 0% means no rain. xác suất — một việc có dễ xảy ra hay không. Mưa 0% là không mưa.
2. outcome: One thing that can happen — heads is one outcome of a coin toss. một khả năng có thể xảy ra — mặt ngửa là một khả năng khi tung đồng xu.
3. sample space (Ω): ALL things that can happen — a coin gives heads, tails. không gian mẫu — TẤT CẢ các khả năng — đồng xu cho ra ngửa, sấp.
4. event: The things you want — even numbers on a die. biến cố — điều mình chọn ra — số chẵn trên xúc xắc.
5. equally likely: All have the same chance — four same tickets. đồng khả năng — vé nào cũng dễ trúng như nhau — bốn vé giống nhau.
6. chance: How easy it is to happen — every student has the same chance. cơ hội — việc đó có dễ xảy ra không — bạn nào cũng như nhau.
7. certain: It WILL happen — the sun rises tomorrow. chắc chắn — nhất định xảy ra — ngày mai mặt trời mọc.
8. possible: It CAN happen — rain tomorrow. có thể xảy ra — ngày mai có thể mưa.
9. impossible: It CANNOT happen — a die shows 7. không thể xảy ra — xúc xắc ra mặt 7.
10. result: What you get at the end — no yellow marbles, so yellow cannot be the result. kết quả — cái mình nhận được cuối cùng — túi không có bi vàng nên vàng không thể là kết quả.
Level Up: Steal one line above and say it about YOUR bag, YOUR coin, YOUR class.Lấy một câu ở trên và nói về túi CỦA BẠN, đồng xu CỦA BẠN, lớp CỦA BẠN.
rooms.label: Learn
rooms.title: Vocab Vault

rooms.content: How it scores: Build each word from its tiles. Fast hands win — this one is competition.Cách tính điểm: xếp từng chữ từ các ô chữ. Tay nhanh thì thắng — trò này thi đấu đấy.
rooms.label: Game
rooms.title: Scramble Sprint

rooms.content:
Scenario: The sample space has…Không gian mẫu gồm…
Scenario: If a thing can happen, it is…Một việc có thể xảy ra thì nó là…
Scenario: Rain is at 0%. It is…Mưa 0%. Nó là…
rooms.label: Test
rooms.title: Prove It

rooms.content:
Linh: We spun 10 times. Portrait came up 4 times. Portrait was our most frequent style.Nhóm mình quay 10 lần. Chân dung ra 4 lần. Chân dung là kiểu ra nhiều nhất.
🤔 Reality check: a report is numbers, not story. Spins, counts, most frequent — then stop.Sự thật: báo cáo là con số, không phải chuyện kể. Số lần quay, số lần ra, cái nhiều nhất — rồi dừng.
Say it: Stand up and report YOUR spinner in three lines — We spun ___ times. ___ came up ___ times. Our most frequent ___ was ___. Then take one team topic (coin, die, marble, month…) and answer its three questions in two minutes.Đứng lên báo cáo vòng quay CỦA BẠN bằng ba câu — We spun ___ times. ___ came up ___ times. Our most frequent ___ was ___. Rồi cùng đội trả lời 3 câu hỏi của một chủ đề (đồng xu, xúc xắc, bi, tháng…) trong hai phút.
rooms.label: Speak
rooms.title: The Spinner Report

rooms.content: How it scores: Ten words, ten meanings. Play in pairs — one reads, one matches. Collaboration.Cách tính điểm: mười từ, mười nghĩa. Chơi theo cặp — một bạn đọc, một bạn nối. Hợp tác nhé.
rooms.label: Game
rooms.title: Word–Meaning Match

rooms.content: How it scores: Sort each event with your team — certain must happen, possible may happen, impossible cannot. Talk first, then tap.Cách tính điểm: cùng đội xếp từng sự việc — certain là chắc chắn, possible là có thể, impossible là không thể. Bàn trước, bấm sau.
rooms.label: Game
rooms.title: The Great Sort

rooms.content:
🎉 You Unlocked the Sample Space Key!🎉 Bạn đã mở khóa Chìa khóa Không gian mẫu!
  • Sample space first: list every thing before you count.Trước hết liệt kê mọi khả năng rồi mới đếm.
  • Event is a choice: the things you want — even, red, abstract.Biến cố là điều mình chọn — chẵn, đỏ, trừu tượng.
  • Three words decide all: certain must happen, possible may happen, impossible cannot.Ba từ quyết định tất cả: certain là chắc chắn, possible là có thể, impossible là không thể.
  • Chance is a fraction: wanted things over all things — 3 out of 6 is one half.Xác suất là một phân số: cái mình muốn chia cho tất cả — 3 trên 6 là một nửa.
  • Say the report: spins, counts, most frequent. Numbers out loud.Đọc báo cáo to tiếng: số lần quay, số lần ra, cái nhiều nhất.
Level Up: Tonight, find one certain, one possible and one impossible thing at home — and say all three to someone. Say it LOUD. Say it WRONG. But SAY IT.Tối nay, tìm một việc chắc chắn, một việc có thể và một việc không thể ở nhà — rồi nói cả ba cho ai đó nghe. Nói TO lên. Nói SAI cũng được. Nhưng PHẢI NÓI.

(function(){

var START=0,PER_CORRECT=10,PER_WRONG=0;

var TIERS=[[5000,'LEGEND'],[500,'TIGER'],[200,'CUB'],[0,'MOUSE']];
function tierOf(n){for(var i=0;i<TIERS.length;i++){if(n>=TIERS[i][0])return TIERS[i][1];}return 'MOUSE';}

function fbClear(){var fb=host.querySelector('.chatty-feedback');if(fb){fb.textContent='';fb.className='chatty-feedback empty';}}
function blockReset(b){b.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('selected','correct','wrong');x.disabled=false;});}
function feedbackReset(){fbClear();host.querySelectorAll('.chatty-choices button').forEach(function(b){b.classList.remove('selected','correct','wrong');b.disabled=false;});}
function showFeedback(msg,type){var fb=host.querySelector('.chatty-feedback');if(fb){fb.className='chatty-feedback feedback-'+type;fb.textContent=msg;}}

  var h='<div class="room active"><div class="room-header"><div class="scene-graphic">'+room.graphic+'</div><div><div class="room-title">'+room.title+'</div><span class="room-label">'+room.label+'</span></div></div>';
  h+=room.content;
  h+='<div class="nav-btns"><button class="nav-btn" data-action="prev"'+(isFirst?' disabled':'')+'><span>\u2b05\ufe0f Back</span></button>';
  h+='<button class="nav-btn" data-action="'+(isLast?'restart':'next')+'"><span>'+(isLast?'\ud83d\udd04 Restart':'Next \u27a1\ufe0f')+'</span></button></div></div>';
  host.innerHTML=h;
  initGames(host);
  progressFill.style.width=(((currentRoom+1)/rooms.length)*100)+'%';
  var rc=document.getElementById('roomCount');if(rc)rc.textContent=(currentRoom+1)+'/'+rooms.length;

  var t=e.target.closest?e.target.closest('button'):null;if(!t)return;
  var action=t.getAttribute('data-action');

  if(action==='next'){if(currentRoom<rooms.length-1){feedbackReset();currentRoom++;render();}return;}
  if(action==='restart'){feedbackReset();currentRoom=0;coins=START;render();renderCoins();return;}
  var answer=t.getAttribute('data-answer');
  if(!answer)return;
  var block=t.closest('.chatty-choices');if(!block)return;

/* ------------------------------- the games ------------------------------- */
function gShuffle(a){for(var i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){var j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1));var t=a[i];a[i]=a[j];a[j]=t;}return a;}
function gPairs(s){return String(s==null?'':s).split(';').map(function(p){var k=String(p).split('=');return {a:(k[0]||'').trim(),b:(k.slice(1).join('=')||'').trim()};}).filter(function(p){return p.a&&p.b;});}
function gHead(el,name,total){el.setAttribute('data-total',String(total));el.setAttribute('data-got','0');return '<div class=\"g-head\"><span class=\"g-name\">'+name+'</span><span class=\"g-score\">0 / '+total+' done</span></div>';}
function gDone(el){var got=(Number(el.getAttribute('data-got'))||0)+1;el.setAttribute('data-got',String(got));var s=el.querySelector('.g-score');var total=Number(el.getAttribute('data-total'))||0;if(s)s.textContent=got+' / '+total+' done';if(total&&got>=total&&s)s.className='g-score win';coins+=PER_CORRECT;renderCoins();}
function gScramble(el){
  var items=gPairs(el.getAttribute('data-items'));
  el.innerHTML=gHead(el,el.getAttribute('data-title')||'🔤 Scramble',items.length)+'<div class=\"g-body\"></div>';
  var body=el.querySelector('.g-body');
  items.forEach(function(it){
    var word=String(it.a).toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]/g,'');
    var row=document.createElement('div');row.className='g-row';
    var hint=document.createElement('div');hint.className='g-hint';hint.textContent=it.b||'';
    var slots=document.createElement('div');slots.className='g-slots';
    var tiles=document.createElement('div');tiles.className='g-tiles';
    var box=document.createElement('span');box.className='g-slot';box.textContent='…';
    var clear=document.createElement('button');clear.className='g-btn ghost';clear.textContent='Clear';
    var built='';
    slots.appendChild(box);slots.appendChild(clear);
    gShuffle(word.split('')).forEach(function(ch){
      var t=document.createElement('button');t.className='g-tile';t.textContent=ch;
      t.addEventListener('click',function(){
        if(row.classList.contains('ok'))return;
        t.classList.add('used');built+=ch;box.textContent=built;
        if(built.length===word.length){
          if(built===word){row.classList.add('ok');box.textContent=word+' \u2713';tiles.querySelectorAll('.g-tile').forEach(function(x){x.classList.add('used');});gDone(el);}
          else{row.classList.add('bad');setTimeout(function(){row.classList.remove('bad');built='';box.textContent='…';tiles.querySelectorAll('.g-tile').forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('used');});},700);}
        }
      });
      tiles.appendChild(t);
    });
    clear.addEventListener('click',function(){if(row.classList.contains('ok'))return;built='';box.textContent='…';tiles.querySelectorAll('.g-tile').forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('used');});});
    row.appendChild(hint);row.appendChild(slots);row.appendChild(tiles);body.appendChild(row);
  });
}
function gMatch(el){
  var items=gPairs(el.getAttribute('data-items'));
  el.innerHTML=gHead(el,el.getAttribute('data-title')||'🔗 Match',items.length)+'<div class=\"g-body g-cols\"></div>';
  var body=el.querySelector('.g-body'),left=document.createElement('div'),right=document.createElement('div');
  body.appendChild(left);body.appendChild(right);
  var pick=null;
  function hit(d){
    if(d.classList.contains('done'))return;
    if(!pick){pick=d;d.classList.add('picked');return;}
    if(pick===d){d.classList.remove('picked');pick=null;return;}
    if(pick.getAttribute('data-side')===d.getAttribute('data-side')){pick.classList.remove('picked');pick=d;d.classList.add('picked');return;}
    var a=pick,b=d;pick=null;a.classList.remove('picked');
    if(a.getAttribute('data-key')===b.getAttribute('data-key')){a.classList.add('done');b.classList.add('done');gDone(el);}
    else{a.classList.add('bad');b.classList.add('bad');setTimeout(function(){a.classList.remove('bad');b.classList.remove('bad');},700);}
  }
  function mk(side,it,ki){var d=document.createElement('div');d.className='g-item';d.textContent=(side==='a'?it.a:it.b);d.setAttribute('data-key',String(ki));d.setAttribute('data-side',side);d.addEventListener('click',function(){hit(d);});return d;}
  gShuffle(items.map(function(it,i){return {it:it,i:i};})).forEach(function(o){left.appendChild(mk('a',o.it,o.i));});
  gShuffle(items.map(function(it,i){return {it:it,i:i};})).forEach(function(o){right.appendChild(mk('b',o.it,o.i));});
}
function gSort(el){
  var groups=String(el.getAttribute('data-groups')||'').split('|').map(function(g){var k=g.split(':');return {name:(k[0]||'').trim(),items:(k.slice(1).join(':')||'').split(',').map(function(x){return x.trim();}).filter(Boolean)};}).filter(function(g){return g.name&&g.items.length;});
  var total=groups.reduce(function(n,g){return n+g.items.length;},0);
  el.innerHTML=gHead(el,el.getAttribute('data-title')||'📦 Sort it out',total)+'<div class=\"g-body\"></div>';
  var body=el.querySelector('.g-body'),chips=document.createElement('div'),buckets=document.createElement('div');
  chips.className='g-chips';buckets.className='g-buckets';
  var pick=null,all=[];
  groups.forEach(function(g){g.items.forEach(function(x){all.push({t:x,g:g.name});});});
  gShuffle(all).forEach(function(o){
    var c=document.createElement('button');c.className='g-tile';c.textContent=o.t;c.setAttribute('data-g',o.g);
    c.addEventListener('click',function(){if(c.classList.contains('used'))return;if(pick)pick.classList.remove('picked');pick=c;c.classList.add('picked');});
    chips.appendChild(c);
  });
  groups.forEach(function(g){
    var b=document.createElement('div');b.className='g-bucket';b.setAttribute('data-g',g.name);b.innerHTML='<b>'+g.name+'</b>';
    b.addEventListener('click',function(){
      if(!pick)return;
      if(pick.getAttribute('data-g')===g.name){
        var c=pick;pick=null;c.classList.remove('picked');c.classList.add('used');c.disabled=true;c.style.display='none';
        var s=document.createElement('span');s.className='g-placed';s.textContent=c.textContent;b.appendChild(s);gDone(el);
      }
      else{b.classList.add('bad');var c2=pick;pick=null;setTimeout(function(){b.classList.remove('bad');if(c2)c2.classList.remove('picked');},700);}
    });
    buckets.appendChild(b);
  });
  body.appendChild(chips);body.appendChild(buckets);
}
function initGames(root){
  if(!root||!root.querySelectorAll)return;
  root.querySelectorAll('.game').forEach(function(el){
    var g=el.getAttribute('data-game');
    try{ if(g==='scramble')gScramble(el); else if(g==='match')gMatch(el); else if(g==='sort')gSort(el); }
    catch(e){ el.innerHTML='<div class=\"g-name\">this game could not start</div>'; }
  });
}
var viBtn=document.getElementById('viToggle');
function viSet(on){try{document.body.classList.toggle('vi-hide',!on);if(viBtn){viBtn.textContent=on?'\ud83c\uddfb\ud83c\uddf3 VI: ON':'\ud83c\uddfb\ud83c\uddf3 VI: OFF';viBtn.setAttribute('aria-pressed',on?'true':'false');if(on){viBtn.classList.remove('off');}else{viBtn.classList.add('off');}}try{if(window.localStorage)window.localStorage.setItem('obi-vi',on?'1':'0');}catch(e){}}catch(e){}}
if(viBtn){viBtn.addEventListener('click',function(){viSet(document.body.classList.contains('vi-hide'));});var viSaved=null;try{viSaved=(window.localStorage?window.localStorage.getItem('obi-vi'):null);}catch(e){}viSet(viSaved!=='0');}
window.ObiLesson={go:function(i){currentRoom=i;render();},rooms:rooms};
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>

voice: Say it LOUD. Say it WRONG. But SAY IT.
Loud and wrong beats silent and correct. Every single time.

rooms.content:
You speak maths out loud today: hands up, a spinner test, and a team report.

Hôm nay bạn nói toán bằng tiếng Anh: giơ tay, thử vòng quay, và báo cáo cùng đội.
  • Say the 10 words of chance in real sentencesNói 10 từ về khả năng trong câu thật
  • Report a real test: what you spun, what came up mostBáo cáo bài thử thật: bạn đã quay gì, cái nào ra nhiều nhất
  • Leave holding the Sample Space KeyRa về với Chìa khóa Không gian mẫu
🤔 Reality check: probability is just counting — wanted things over all things.Sự thật: xác suất chỉ là đếm — cái mình muốn chia cho tất cả.
Pro Tip: Loud and wrong beats silent and correct. Every time.Nói to mà sai còn hơn im lặng mà đúng. Lần nào cũng vậy.
rooms.label: Warm-Up
rooms.title: The Entrance

rooms.content:
Teacher: Eight lines. Right hand TRUE, left hand FALSE. Five seconds — go!Tám câu. Tay phải là ĐÚNG, tay trái là SAI. Năm giây — bắt đầu!
Minh: A bag with red and blue marbles only… yellow? Left hand! No yellow here.Túi chỉ có bi đỏ và bi xanh… màu vàng? Tay trái! Ở đây không có màu vàng.
Linh: A coin has two outcomes: heads or tails. Three? Left hand. False!Đồng xu có hai khả năng: ngửa hoặc sấp. Ba ư? Tay trái. Sai!
Minh: Four same tickets — same chance each. Right hand. Equally likely!Bốn vé giống nhau — vé nào cũng dễ trúng như nhau. Tay phải. Đồng khả năng!
Teacher: One sentence each — WHY? Short and loud.Mỗi bạn một câu — VÌ SAO? Ngắn và to.
🤔 Reality check: each answer is a counting claim. Count the things, and the words follow.Sự thật: mỗi câu trả lời là một phép đếm. Đếm xong, từ sẽ theo.
Pro Tip: Start with Because… Say the reason, not the rule.Bắt đầu bằng Vì… Nói lý do, đừng đọc luật.
rooms.label: Scene
rooms.title: Hands Up, Speak Out

rooms.content:
Linh: We get the painting spinner: portrait, landscape, abstract, still life. Ten spins each? 📱Nhóm mình lấy vòng quay tranh: chân dung, phong cảnh, trừu tượng, tĩnh vật. Mỗi bạn quay 10 lần nhé?
Minh: Deal. I spin, you write each result. Then we report what came up most.Chốt. Tớ quay, cậu ghi từng kết quả. Rồi mình báo cáo cái nào ra nhiều nhất.
Linh: Our sample space is the four styles. The event we want: abstract.Không gian mẫu của mình là bốn kiểu tranh. Biến cố mình muốn: trừu tượng.
💬 Reality check: planning out loud IS the speaking task warming up — you rehearse the report before you give it.Sự thật: lên kế hoạch to tiếng CHÍNH LÀ khởi động cho bài nói — bạn đang tập báo cáo trước khi báo cáo thật.
Pro Tip: Plan in full sentences now, and the report later is just reading your own words back.Giờ lên kế hoạch bằng câu đầy đủ, lát nữa báo cáo chỉ là đọc lại lời của chính mình.
rooms.label: Text Scene
rooms.title: The Spinner Plan

rooms.content:
1. probability: How likely something is — rain at 0% means no rain. xác suất — một việc có dễ xảy ra hay không. Mưa 0% là không mưa.
2. outcome: One thing that can happen — heads is one outcome of a coin toss. một khả năng có thể xảy ra — mặt ngửa là một khả năng khi tung đồng xu.
3. sample space (Ω): ALL things that can happen — a coin gives heads, tails. không gian mẫu — TẤT CẢ các khả năng — đồng xu cho ra ngửa, sấp.
4. event: The things you want — even numbers on a die. biến cố — điều mình chọn ra — số chẵn trên xúc xắc.
5. equally likely: All have the same chance — four same tickets. đồng khả năng — vé nào cũng dễ trúng như nhau — bốn vé giống nhau.
6. chance: How easy it is to happen — every student has the same chance. cơ hội — việc đó có dễ xảy ra không — bạn nào cũng như nhau.
7. certain: It WILL happen — the sun rises tomorrow. chắc chắn — nhất định xảy ra — ngày mai mặt trời mọc.
8. possible: It CAN happen — rain tomorrow. có thể xảy ra — ngày mai có thể mưa.
9. impossible: It CANNOT happen — a die shows 7. không thể xảy ra — xúc xắc ra mặt 7.
10. result: What you get at the end — no yellow marbles, so yellow cannot be the result. kết quả — cái mình nhận được cuối cùng — túi không có bi vàng nên vàng không thể là kết quả.
Level Up: Steal one line above and say it about YOUR bag, YOUR coin, YOUR class.Lấy một câu ở trên và nói về túi CỦA BẠN, đồng xu CỦA BẠN, lớp CỦA BẠN.
rooms.label: Learn
rooms.title: Vocab Vault

rooms.content: How it scores: Build each word from its tiles. Fast hands win — this one is competition.Cách tính điểm: xếp từng chữ từ các ô chữ. Tay nhanh thì thắng — trò này thi đấu đấy.
rooms.label: Game
rooms.title: Scramble Sprint

rooms.content:
Scenario: The sample space has…Không gian mẫu gồm…
Scenario: If a thing can happen, it is…Một việc có thể xảy ra thì nó là…
Scenario: Rain is at 0%. It is…Mưa 0%. Nó là…
rooms.label: Test
rooms.title: Prove It

rooms.content:
Linh: We spun 10 times. Portrait came up 4 times. Portrait was our most frequent style.Nhóm mình quay 10 lần. Chân dung ra 4 lần. Chân dung là kiểu ra nhiều nhất.
🤔 Reality check: a report is numbers, not story. Spins, counts, most frequent — then stop.Sự thật: báo cáo là con số, không phải chuyện kể. Số lần quay, số lần ra, cái nhiều nhất — rồi dừng.
Say it: Stand up and report YOUR spinner in three lines — We spun ___ times. ___ came up ___ times. Our most frequent ___ was ___. Then take one team topic (coin, die, marble, month…) and answer its three questions in two minutes.Đứng lên báo cáo vòng quay CỦA BẠN bằng ba câu — We spun ___ times. ___ came up ___ times. Our most frequent ___ was ___. Rồi cùng đội trả lời 3 câu hỏi của một chủ đề (đồng xu, xúc xắc, bi, tháng…) trong hai phút.
rooms.label: Speak
rooms.title: The Spinner Report

rooms.content: How it scores: Ten words, ten meanings. Play in pairs — one reads, one matches. Collaboration.Cách tính điểm: mười từ, mười nghĩa. Chơi theo cặp — một bạn đọc, một bạn nối. Hợp tác nhé.
rooms.label: Game
rooms.title: Word–Meaning Match

rooms.content: How it scores: Sort each event with your team — certain must happen, possible may happen, impossible cannot. Talk first, then tap.Cách tính điểm: cùng đội xếp từng sự việc — certain là chắc chắn, possible là có thể, impossible là không thể. Bàn trước, bấm sau.
rooms.label: Game
rooms.title: The Great Sort

rooms.content:
🎉 You Unlocked the Sample Space Key!🎉 Bạn đã mở khóa Chìa khóa Không gian mẫu!
  • Sample space first: list every thing before you count.Trước hết liệt kê mọi khả năng rồi mới đếm.
  • Event is a choice: the things you want — even, red, abstract.Biến cố là điều mình chọn — chẵn, đỏ, trừu tượng.
  • Three words decide all: certain must happen, possible may happen, impossible cannot.Ba từ quyết định tất cả: certain là chắc chắn, possible là có thể, impossible là không thể.
  • Chance is a fraction: wanted things over all things — 3 out of 6 is one half.Xác suất là một phân số: cái mình muốn chia cho tất cả — 3 trên 6 là một nửa.
  • Say the report: spins, counts, most frequent. Numbers out loud.Đọc báo cáo to tiếng: số lần quay, số lần ra, cái nhiều nhất.
Level Up: Tonight, find one certain, one possible and one impossible thing at home — and say all three to someone. Say it LOUD. Say it WRONG. But SAY IT.Tối nay, tìm một việc chắc chắn, một việc có thể và một việc không thể ở nhà — rồi nói cả ba cho ai đó nghe. Nói TO lên. Nói SAI cũng được. Nhưng PHẢI NÓI.
rooms.label: Mastery
rooms.title: The Exit

<script>
(function(){

var START=0,PER_CORRECT=10,PER_WRONG=0;
var rooms=window.__LESSON_ROOMS__||[];
var currentRoom=0,coins=START;
